title: PostgreSQL Developer

nodes.title: PostgreSQL Architecture & Memory Model
nodes.subtitle: Postmaster, client backends, shared memory (shared_buffers, wal_buffers), work_mem, maintenance_work_mem
learning_objectives: Explain the role of shared_buffers and OS page cache in PostgreSQL read operations
Configure work_mem appropriately for complex sorting and hash join queries
feynman_prompts: Why does setting work_mem too high risk out-of-memory (OOM) crashes on high-connection servers?
key_misconceptions: Setting shared_buffers to 90% of system RAM, starving the OS page cache

nodes.title: PostgreSQL Advanced Data Types & Schema DDL
nodes.subtitle: Numeric, text, UUID, TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, JSONB, arrays, custom domain constraints
learning_objectives: Choose optimal data types for performance (UUIDv7 vs serial, TIMESTAMPTZ vs TIMESTAMP)
Enforce database-level data integrity using CHECK and EXCLUDE constraints
feynman_prompts: Why should timestamps always be stored as TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE in production databases?
key_misconceptions: Using VARCHAR(255) arbitrarily when PostgreSQL treats TEXT with equal performance

nodes.title: Complex Joins, Aggregations & Grouping Sets
nodes.subtitle: Nested loop, hash join, merge join, GROUP BY, ROLLUP, CUBE, GROUPING SETS
learning_objectives: Write complex analytical queries using GROUPING SETS, ROLLUP, and CUBE
Predict when the PostgreSQL optimizer chooses Hash Joins vs Nested Loops vs Merge Joins
feynman_prompts: Explain the difference between a Hash Join and a Nested Loop join in PostgreSQL query execution.
key_misconceptions: Writing CROSS JOINs unintentionally due to missing join predicate conditions

nodes.title: Analytical SQL: Window Functions Mastery
nodes.subtitle: OVER(), PARTITION BY, ORDER BY, ROW_NUMBER(), RANK(), DENSE_RANK(), LAG(), LEAD(), rolling averages
learning_objectives: Calculate moving averages, running totals, and period-over-period growth with window functions
De-duplicate records and assign sequential row numbers within grouped partitions
feynman_prompts: How do window functions calculate aggregates without collapsing rows like GROUP BY does?
key_misconceptions: Attempting to filter window function results in the WHERE clause instead of using a CTE or subquery

nodes.title: Common Table Expressions (CTEs) & Recursive SQL
nodes.subtitle: WITH queries, materialized vs inlined CTEs, recursive CTEs for hierarchical tree traversal
learning_objectives: Traverse hierarchical organizational charts and graph structures using recursive CTEs
Structure multi-stage queries cleanly using readability-enhancing WITH clauses
feynman_prompts: How does a recursive CTE evaluate its anchor member and recursive member until termination?
key_misconceptions: Writing recursive CTEs without termination conditions, resulting in infinite query loops

nodes.title: JSONB Document Modeling & GIN Indexing
nodes.subtitle: JSON vs JSONB, jsonb operators (->, ->>, @>, ?), GIN indexes, indexing specific JSON paths
learning_objectives: Store and query semi-structured JSON documents with high performance using JSONB
Accelerate JSONB containment (@>) queries using Generalized Inverted Indexes (GIN)
feynman_prompts: Why is JSONB significantly faster to query than plain JSON in PostgreSQL?
key_misconceptions: Overusing JSONB for deeply relational entity models where foreign keys should be used

nodes.title: B-Tree Indexing Mechanics & Leftmost Prefix Rule
nodes.subtitle: B-Tree page structure, root/branch/leaf pages, composite indexes, index-only scans, include columns
learning_objectives: Design composite B-Tree indexes adhering to the leftmost prefix rule and query selectivity
Enable high-speed Index-Only Scans by adding non-key columns using the INCLUDE clause
feynman_prompts: Why does an index on (last_name, first_name) speed up searches for last_name but NOT first_name alone?
key_misconceptions: Creating single-column indexes on every table column and expecting composite queries to be fast

nodes.title: Query Optimization with EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)
nodes.subtitle: Cost estimation, actual vs estimated rows, seq scans, index scans, bitmap index scans, buffers
learning_objectives: Diagnose slow queries using EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) and identify missing index opportunities
Resolve discrepancies between estimated rows and actual rows by refreshing table statistics
feynman_prompts: Why does a large discrepancy between estimated and actual rows cause the planner to pick suboptimal join strategies?
key_misconceptions: Running EXPLAIN without ANALYZE and assuming estimated costs equal real-world wall-clock latency

nodes.title: Specialized Indexes: GIN, GiST, BRIN & Partial Indexes
nodes.subtitle: GIN for arrays/text, GiST for geometry/ranges, BRIN for massive append-only timeseries, partial indexes
learning_objectives: Index massive billion-row append-only time-series tables efficiently using lightweight BRIN indexes
Reduce index storage overhead by 90% using conditional partial indexes (WHERE is_active = true)
feynman_prompts: Why are BRIN indexes exceptionally tiny and fast for sorted time-series data compared to B-Trees?
key_misconceptions: Building standard B-Tree indexes on large text documents instead of using full-text GIN indexes

nodes.title: Multi-Version Concurrency Control (MVCC) & Isolation
nodes.subtitle: Tuple versions (xmin, xmax), vacuuming dead tuples, Read Committed, Repeatable Read, Serializable
learning_objectives: Explain how MVCC allows readers to never block writers and writers to never block readers
Prevent non-repeatable reads and serialization anomalies using appropriate isolation levels
feynman_prompts: How does PostgreSQL MVCC mark updated rows as deleted tuples rather than overwriting in place?
key_misconceptions: Assuming that UPDATE statements overwrite existing table disk space directly without generating dead tuples

nodes.title: VACUUM, Autovacuum Architecture & Bloat Prevention
nodes.subtitle: Dead tuple cleanup, page freezing, transaction ID wraparound, autovacuum worker tuning, pg_stat_activity
learning_objectives: Tune autovacuum settings (vacuum_scale_factor, cost_limit) to prevent crippling table bloat
Monitor and mitigate database-wide transaction ID (txid) wraparound emergencies
feynman_prompts: Why does disabling autovacuum inevitably lead to database outage due to transaction ID wraparound?
key_misconceptions: Running manual VACUUM FULL during peak production hours, locking tables exclusively

nodes.title: Declarative Table Partitioning (Range, List, Hash)
nodes.subtitle: Declarative partitioning, PARTITION BY RANGE, partition pruning, maintenance automation, pg_partman
learning_objectives: Partition massive multi-million row event tables by timestamp range (monthly/daily partitions)
Verify that queries benefit from automated partition pruning during execution
feynman_prompts: How does partition pruning eliminate entire disk partitions from scan plans during query execution?
key_misconceptions: Partitioning small tables with under 100,000 rows, adding query overhead without performance gain

nodes.title: Stored Procedures, Functions & Triggers in PL/pgSQL
nodes.subtitle: CREATE FUNCTION vs PROCEDURE, transactional control inside procedures, BEFORE/AFTER triggers
learning_objectives: Write high-performance procedural business logic using PL/pgSQL functions and triggers
Audit table mutations automatically by authoring AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE triggers
feynman_prompts: What is the fundamental difference between a PostgreSQL FUNCTION and a PROCEDURE with respect to transactions?
key_misconceptions: Putting complex application domain business logic inside triggers where it becomes invisible and hard to debug

nodes.title: Connection Pooling with PgBouncer
nodes.subtitle: Session pooling, transaction pooling, connection overhead, max_connections tuning, auth types
learning_objectives: Deploy PgBouncer in transaction pooling mode to support 10,000+ concurrent client connections
Configure application connection pool recycling and server connection limits
feynman_prompts: Why does each direct PostgreSQL backend process consume significant RAM and fork overhead?
key_misconceptions: Using prepared statements with PgBouncer transaction pooling without enabling appropriate protocol support

nodes.title: PostgreSQL Full-Text Search (tsvector & tsquery)
nodes.subtitle: to_tsvector, to_tsquery, English dictionaries, stemming, GIN text indexing, websearch_to_tsquery
learning_objectives: Build fast, typo-tolerant full-text search engines natively within PostgreSQL using tsvector
Rank search results by relevance using ts_rank and ts_rank_cd
feynman_prompts: How does linguistic stemming in tsvector allow searches for 'run' to match 'running' and 'ran'?
key_misconceptions: Using slow, un-indexed LIKE '%keyword%' wildcards for user text search queries

nodes.title: Physical & Logical Replication (HA Clusters)
nodes.subtitle: Streaming replication, write-ahead logs (WAL), replication slots, Patroni HA, failover automation
learning_objectives: Deploy streaming replication with hot standby read replicas across availability zones
Automate PostgreSQL primary failover and leader election using Patroni and etcd
feynman_prompts: What is the difference between physical streaming replication (byte-for-byte) and logical replication?
key_misconceptions: Creating replication slots without active standbys, causing WAL disk exhaustion on the primary server

nodes.title: Backup, WAL Archiving & Point-In-Time Recovery (PITR)
nodes.subtitle: pg_dump vs pg_basebackup, WAL archiving to S3, continuous archiving, Point-In-Time Recovery
learning_objectives: Configure continuous WAL archiving and restore a production database to an exact second in time
Execute automated daily physical backups with pgBackRest or WAL-G
feynman_prompts: Why is Point-In-Time Recovery (PITR) capable of recovering data up to the second before an accidental DROP TABLE?
key_misconceptions: Relying exclusively on logical pg_dump backups for multi-terabyte production databases

nodes.title: Database Security, Hardening & Row-Level Security (RLS)
nodes.subtitle: pg_hba.conf, SSL connections, role inheritance, Row-Level Security (RLS) policies, pgcrypto
learning_objectives: Isolate multi-tenant data securely using PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) policies
Enforce TLS encrypted connections and least-privilege role permissions via pg_hba.conf
feynman_prompts: How does Row-Level Security enforce tenant data isolation directly at the database engine level?
key_misconceptions: Granting the public database application user SUPERUSER permissions

description: Master PostgreSQL Developer with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 18 core and advanced milestones.
